tools.name: helloworld.announce.greetings
tools.description: Greet a person with optional tone, context, and presentation details.

inputSchema.description: Build a greeting with optional tone, audience, timing, and presentation details.

text.description: Optional opening phrase, such as Hello or Welcome.

number.description: Optional enthusiasm level used to vary the greeting punctuation.

json.description: Optional JSON persona details to acknowledge.

array.description: Optional audience members to greet alongside the named person.

booleanValue.description: Use a formal greeting when true; use a casual greeting when false.
booleanValue.title: Boolean value

date.description: Optional occasion date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

binary.description: Optional Base64 ceremony seal; its presence adds a sealed note.

nullValue.description: Optional explicit null marker; it requests a deliberate silent beat.

url.description: Optional URL to cite as the greeting's inspiration.

file.description: Optional file reference to mention as an attachment.

unknown.description: Optional untyped value to acknowledge without interpreting.

secret.description: Optional private sign-off; its value is never returned.

code.description: Optional code phrase that turns the greeting into a developer salutation.

email.description: Optional reply address to include in the greeting.

decimal.description: Optional decimal warmth multiplier used in the tone note.

image.description: Optional image reference used as the greeting backdrop.

clock.description: Optional clock reading that makes the greeting time-aware.

time.description: Optional meeting time in HH:mm form.

duration.description: Optional duration to describe the intended pause or celebration.

interval.description: Optional availability interval to include in the greeting.

color.description: Optional color that gives the greeting a visual mood.

location.description: Optional named location to mention in the greeting.

geo.description: Optional geographic coordinates or feature to acknowledge.

tools.name: powershell.cli.execute
tools.title: Execute PowerShell Script
tools.description: Runs a PowerShell script and returns ordered execution tracks, stdout, stderr, exit code, duration, and status.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to the current JVM working directory.

timeoutMs.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 and is capped by the tool.

executable.description: Optional PowerShell executable. Defaults to pwsh. Use powershell.exe for Windows PowerShell.

environment.description: Optional environment variables to add or override for the child process.

includeScriptInStructuredContent.description: Whether to echo the script body in structuredContent. Defaults to false.
